Tokenised search is case-insensitive: "LOGIN BUG" (uppercase) matches same issue as "login bug"

Filter: issueType=Bug narrows to SEARCH-1 and SEARCH-4
Filter: priority=High narrows to SEARCH-1 and SEARCH-4
Filter: assigneeAccountId=acc-alice returns SEARCH-1 and SEARCH-3
Filter: labels=urgent returns SEARCH-1 and SEARCH-4
Filter: labels=urgent + labels=payment (AND) returns only SEARCH-4 (has both)
Filter: updatedFrom=2026-03-12 + updatedTo=2026-03-22 returns SEARCH-3 and SEARCH-4
Combined: status=Open + issueType=Bug → SEARCH-1 and SEARCH-4 (both Open Bugs)
Combined: priority=High + assigneeAccountId=acc-alice → only SEARCH-1
Combined: q=fix + status=Open + issueType=Bug → only SEARCH-4
